## Schedule Rules

- Agents run once per week on the assigned day.
- Same-day agents are staggered by 30 minutes.
- Agents do not coordinate in real time.
- Agents should read their journal before filing new work.
- Agents should avoid duplicate Issues and PRs.
- Agents should stay inside the file boundaries defined in their prompt.
